text: New Check for update button under App updates. The installed app can also check overnight, when the browser allows it.
Three new colour themes. Pick one light and one dark. The moon and sun button, or Device dark mode setting, switches between them.
My preferences is now sorted into tabs down the left: Colours, Pictures and text, Main page layout, Reminders and General.
The Help guide now has its own steps for the unlocked layout, and covers the newest features.
Scan a barcode now reads the barcode only, with no warnings. If the camera cannot read it, the number under it can be typed.
Admin has an Editing tab to allow or turn off each Remove and Undo, and to choose whether a reason is asked.
Admin has a Restore tab. A backup file can be loaded back in as a full restore, or merged with chosen kinds of data.
